preconditions.description: root is an instance of TreeNode

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or isinstance(node.nextRight, type(None)) for node in traverse_tree(root, 'level_order'))
postconditions.description: All nodes at the same level are connected by nextRight pointers, and these pointers are set to None if there is no next node at the same level.

postconditions.expression: all(node.nextRight is None or isinstance(node.nextRight, type(None)) for node in traverse_tree(root, 'in_order'))
postconditions.description: The in-order traversal of the tree after connecting nodes at the same level should not have any nextRight pointers pointing to a node.
